profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer based in the Bay Area. Currently working on the platform products team at C3.ai

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked within the Platform – Cloud organization on the full-stack team. 

Notable work:
	•	C3.AI VSCode Extension: Played a key role in developing this extension, enabling developers to build AI applications seamlessly on our cloud platform.
	•	Cloud Cluster Dashboard Enhancements: Improved administrative control and operational efficiency by introducing advanced resource management features and a resource hibernation capability.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Fixed bugs and implemented enhancements to the bank’s online platform and content management system, which uses the ASP.NET MVC framework and languages which include C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL.
• Utilized DocuSign’s API to integrate it into the CMS user interface for quicker access to important bank documents.
• Built a proof-of-concept credit checker tool powered by Experian’s API and ASP.NET,  with the goal of streamlining the bank’s credit offer and decisioning process.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Worked for the Film & TV department office, specifically in handling gear checkout for film students.
• Wrote and maintained a python script which tremendously enhances the checkout process for both staff and students. Office now uses script daily.

honors.title: ESTEEM Scholar
honors.description: Recipient for UCSB’s ESTEEM (Enhancing Success in Transfer Education for Engineering Major) Scholarship, and induction into the ESTEEM program.

projects.title: Top Songs By Year
projects.description:
Android application written in Java that lets the user select a year, and then shows the billboard top 100 songs of that year in a custom list-view with corresponding images.

Uses Volley and Glide to get html and image data from the internet, and parses the html using JSoup.

projects.title: Calculator
projects.description:
An arithmetic calculator written in Java, using the swing toolkit for its GUI.
Implements an undo feature, as well as an option to save the log in either plain text or pseudo-xml format.
